_comment: Atlas Growth :: US residential water / mold / fire restoration contractors, sourced from the remediational.com directory (NOT a Maps scrape: no runsheet, no tiles; the import script in the run folder maps the directory's 12 service tags onto google_types so the engine's qualify grammar applies unchanged). Operator 2026-10-11: all 506 metros, review floor 0. VOLUME-SAFE posture as on the pool run: the real ICP gate is the STEP 5e site-text classify (classify-prompt.md), so nothing here may drop a plausible restoration firm. Job-specific values live ONLY here.

geo._r: Directory import: every row carries a US state + ZIP from the source, so footprint-gate.js (hub distance vs a runsheet) is not run — recorded in RUN-NOTES. region_from_city reads the state token the import writes into city as 'City, ST' (used by the STEP 6 cascade).

categories._r: The 12 directory service tags, mapped by import-remediational.js to these pseudo google_types (bit order = the directory's tags[] order). Remediation tags are ICP; testing / asbestos / lead are the inspection-and-abatement trades and only count when they ride with a remediation tag.

qualify_rules._r: 1. NAME deny (always fires). Entity kinds that are never a buyer of a residential lead-gen retainer: pre-purchase home inspectors, public adjusters, engineering practices, labs, consultancies, trainers, suppliers, civic bodies, insurers, realty, law. Every term is multi-word or unambiguous (substring trap). Deliberately ABSENT: 'consulting' / 'consultants' (dry-run 2026-10-11: dropped 'Sunrise Restoration & Consulting' and 'Insight Environmental Testing & Consulting', both carrying remediation tags — the classify decides those), bare 'inspection' / 'inspector' / 'testing' / 'environmental' (a remediator is often 'XYZ Mold Inspection & Remediation' or 'ABC Environmental' — the allow rule and the classify decide those), bare 'engineering' kept OUT too ('Restoration Engineering' is a plausible firm name); only the practice compounds are denied. NO franchise names anywhere — operator directive: keep the roll-up, flag the brand (brand_families).
qualify_rules.label: name_deny

qualify_rules._r: 2. Positive allow on google_types-ANY: the row must carry at least one REMEDIATION tag. Rows tagged only testing / asbestos / lead (home inspectors, assessment-only licensees, abatement-only firms — ~5,100 rows) drop here as not_in_icp and are re-admittable at $0 by re-running qualify on excluded_officp.csv with those terms added. Substring-matched against the pseudo google_types the import writes.
qualify_rules.label: not_in_icp

_no_review_floor: Operator 2026-10-11: review floor 0. No too_small rule. Directory rows with 0 reviews (4,195) ride through to the site-text gate; the deliverable carries rating + review count + pct_5star so the operator can floor it later at $0.
_no_website_rule: No {website, exists} rule (as every Atlas config). collapse-domains.js classifies website as site / shared_host / none after qualify; no-website rows are the STEP 5d recovery track.
_no_chain_drop: No franchise deny anywhere. brand_families below flags the branch; location_count is the free multi-location signal. Franchise branch sites are the brand site (servpro.com/locations/...), so a branch is classified on the brand's text, fanned from the domain representative, and the brand flag is where the operator decides to work or skip the segment.

brand_families._r: US restoration franchise / roll-up families on the directory. Lowercase SUBSTRING match against '<name> <root_domain>' (collapse-domains.js), so every term is distinctive. Measured on the directory 2026-10-11 by name: SERVPRO 1,373 · ServiceMaster 608 · PuroClean 343 · Paul Davis 219 · 911 Restoration 156 · other brands ~1,170.

owner_query._r: Same cascade as the pool run. DataForSEO backend only if DATAFORSEO_LOGIN/PASSWORD are in the skill .env this session; otherwise the in-session read + BBB rung are the owner rungs. --max-cost REQUIRED on any SERP run; probe 100 Qualified leads under $1 first.
